pages.text: Some ingredients added by Alchemical Power cannot be obtained by growing crops, and are prepared with the Rune of Fruits.$(br2)They are compatible with ingredients added by other farming mods.
Ingredients such as flour and raw pasta are used as materials for other dishes.
Sauces are used in pasta, stews, and other dishes.
Preparing seasonings and processed ingredients expands the range of dishes you can make.
Combining the Cookware Set with ingredients lets you craft a variety of dishes.
You can also make snacks and sweets, not just meals.
